Phase 1 RCA (pre-repair):

Step 0 dossier:
- Step 0(a): duplicate/history sweep for `anthropic httpx2 http_client rejects AsyncClient` found this bug (2bd6) and its stopgap predecessor 1f35; no separate open duplicate was identified in the targeted search. `rebar list --type bug --status open,in_progress` was run for the required open-bug sweep.
- Step 0(b): no report build quoted in this ticket; using created_at=1788111163572289990 gives floor 580125bf3ff65003a063c3358a50d12f0a3b99a4. Suspect paths changed since (notably 254e jitter/backoff and 1f35 cap commits).
- Step 0(c): fresh worktree debug-2bd6-httpx2 is current at 1d9193332139894cc46f5e7385e070d8bd06d5a2 (= origin/main).

Confirmed mechanism: with anthropic 1.2.0 installed, `AsyncAnthropic.__init__` annotates `http_client: httpx2.AsyncClient | None`, while `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py:212-215` still constructs a stdlib `httpx.AsyncClient` and passes it as `http_client`. Runtime reproduction in the fresh worktree raises exactly: `TypeError: Invalid http_client argument; Expected an instance of httpx2.AsyncClient but got <class 'httpx.AsyncClient'>` from `anthropic/_client.py:692` when `_build_retrying_anthropic_provider()` reaches `anthropic_model.py:214`.

Legitimacy: incomplete-implementation/defect under this ticket's approved Decision 6 scope and 1f35's stopgap: 1f35 documents that the `<1` SDK cap only keeps mirror-sweep legs off the httpx2 line until this seam is adapted; 2bd6 explicitly approves adapting the seam and lifting/widening the cap while preserving 254e Retry-After+jitter semantics.

Attribution: env-integration escape attributed to `morbid-uncultured-arcticduck` / 95a5-41eb-cffd-477b by scope and commit evidence. Commit 434dc0a5779f164a082cd688783d71024fd93837 (rebar-ticket: morbid-uncultured-arcticduck) introduced the transport-layer retry seam and the custom `httpx.AsyncClient` passed to Anthropic with SDK retries disabled. Later 254e (5c28ce66...) only hardened wait semantics and 1f35 (cd40322e...) was the temporary cap, not the origin. The external anthropic 1.x/httpx2 contract created the obligation, but the rebar work item that owned this custom-client integration is 95a5/morbid.

Planned repair: preserve the existing stdlib-httpx path for pre-httpx2 SDKs, detect SDKs whose `http_client` contract names `httpx2.AsyncClient`, build an equivalent httpx2 client/transport with the same tenacity retry predicate, wait strategy, SDK `max_retries=0`, timeout, teardown, and Retry-After/jitter semantics, then lift the 1f35 direct upper bound.

comments.body:
Final rebar-debug report for 2bd6-ff87-d48c-4a65 / unsavoury-desertic-ant.

Problem: Anthropic 1.x/httpx2 rejects rebar's retrying Anthropic seam because the seam passed a stdlib `httpx.AsyncClient`.

Proven root cause: `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py:_build_retrying_anthropic_provider` was hard-coded to stdlib httpx client/transport/exception types. Under `anthropic==1.2.0`, `AsyncAnthropic.__init__` requires `httpx2.AsyncClient`, producing `TypeError: Expected an instance of httpx2.AsyncClient but got <class 'httpx.AsyncClient'>`. The fix is at `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py:107-117,133-178,185-212,299-340`.

Proof: reproduced the exact TypeError against `anthropic==1.2.0`; signature inspection showed 1.2.0 annotation `httpx2.AsyncClient | None` and 0.121.0 annotation `httpx.AsyncClient | None`. Anthropic 1.2.0 beta `messages.create` also drops `temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k` but accepts `extra_body`. MockTransport experiments proved httpx2 client construction, retry, and sampling-through-extra_body work.

Defect origin: caused_by recorded to `morbid-uncultured-arcticduck` / `95a5-41eb-cffd-477b`, commit `434dc0a5779f164a082cd688783d71024fd93837`, which introduced the custom stdlib-httpx transport-owned retry seam. 1f35 was only the stopgap cap; 254e hardened the same seam but did not create the upstream httpx2 obligation.

Tests: RED/GREEN coverage in `tests/unit/test_transport_retry.py:243-310`; provider-parity and harness compatibility coverage in `tests/unit/test_provider_parity.py`, `test_llm_fallback_chain.py`, `test_agentic_message_cache.py`, `test_llm_provider_factory.py`, `test_llm_timeouts.py`, `test_cache_prefix_breakpoint.py`, `test_candidate_tracing.py`, `test_candidate_tracing_oracle.py`, and `test_llm_config_gate_root.py`; dependency contract in `tests/unit/test_packaging_dependencies.py`. The RED oracle failed before the seam fix and passed after. Sandboxed mutation reintroduced stdlib-httpx / sampling-drop defects and returned the targeted tests to RED.

Fix: select the SDK's expected HTTP module from the `AsyncAnthropic` signature; build stdlib httpx for pre-1 SDKs and httpx2 for 1.x; share RetryConfig/wait/validate logic; add an httpx2 tenacity transport fallback; coerce timeouts; move unsupported real sampling kwargs to `extra_body`; widen `anthropic` to `>=0.121.0,<2`.

Scope & safety: caller sweep found production `ProviderSession._build_anthropic` plus direct helper tests; all affected MockTransport harnesses were updated. The fix restores approved Decision-6 compatibility, adds no new dependency, and weakens no tests.

Siblings: construct sweep found no other production Anthropic custom-client seams; test harness siblings listed above were fixed. Parity sweep: ProviderSession remains the single production channel for Anthropic provider construction; no missing CLI/MCP/library surface.

Residual risk & prevention: pydantic-ai's future first-party `HTTPX2TenacityTransport` is handled opportunistically if present; pinned version lacks it. Private pydantic-ai dispatch through `client.beta.messages.create` is guarded by a spy test so a future refactor fails loudly. No undispositioned fragility remains.

Replication: merged Gerrit change 2470 as commit `90957179ed7b9a290ebefec5ff77d76945385834`; LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1. Post-merge local replication on origin/main: targeted httpx2/provider-parity tests passed (5 passed), and `rebar verify-commit-ticket --rev HEAD` resolved this ticket.

compiled_state.description:
## Context

Split from `floating-chromium-leafwing` (1f35-74fc-47a0-4d71), Decision 6 (operator-approved 2026-08-30). 1f35 was the stopgap: bound `anthropic` below the first httpx2-vendoring release (`<1`) so mirror-sweep legs stopped floating to SDKs whose `http_client` contract rejects a stdlib `httpx.AsyncClient`. The dependency boundary is `1.0.0`: `anthropic` 1.x (including the reproduced `1.2.0`) declares and validates `httpx2`, while `0.121.0` remains the pre-httpx2 line. This ticket is the approved long-term fix: adapt rebar's Anthropic provider seam for both contracts and widen the temporary cap.

## Observed SDK contract evidence

- `anthropic==1.2.0`: `inspect.signature(anthropic.AsyncAnthropic.__init__).parameters["http_client"].annotation` prints `httpx2.AsyncClient | None`; constructing with stdlib `httpx.AsyncClient` raises `TypeError: Invalid http_client argument; Expected an instance of httpx2.AsyncClient but got <class 'httpx.AsyncClient'>`.
- `anthropic==0.121.0`: the same annotation prints `httpx.AsyncClient | None`, so the pre-httpx2 path must stay stdlib-httpx compatible.
- `anthropic==1.2.0` beta `messages.create` parameters include `extra_body` and `timeout`, but do **not** include `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k`; `anthropic==0.121.0` includes all three sampling kwargs and `extra_body`.
- A local spike against `anthropic==1.2.0` showed `httpx2.AsyncClient(transport=httpx2.MockTransport(...))` is accepted and `extra_body={"temperature": 0.0}` is merged into the outbound JSON body as top-level `temperature`.
- Inspection of the pinned pydantic-ai dispatch path shows `.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pydantic_ai/models/anthropic.py:713` calls `self.client.beta.messages.create(...)` inside `_messages_create`; it is an instance-attribute lookup at request time, not a method captured at model construction.

## Why this followed eb64 / 254e

The changed seam is `src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py:_build_retrying_anthropic_provider`, inside epic `financial-stoneware-brant` (eb64-844b-ab7a-4915) and overlapping 254e. 254e's invariant is transport-owned retry: rebar supplies the HTTP client, sets `AsyncAnthropic(max_retries=0)`, retries transient 429/529/5xx plus timeout/network errors below the agent loop, honors positive `Retry-After`, and falls back to jitter. This fix preserves that invariant; it does not switch to SDK-managed retries.

## Plan

- Choose the type-detected custom-client branch because it is the branch compatible with 254e's `max_retries=0` transport-owned retry invariant.
- Detect the SDK contract by reading `inspect.signature(AsyncAnthropic.__init__).parameters["http_client"].annotation`; match annotation text containing `httpx2.AsyncClient`, which covers the observed 1.2.0 forward-ref/union string `httpx2.AsyncClient | None`. Default to stdlib `httpx` when the annotation is absent or ambiguous.
- Build one shared `RetryConfig` and one shared `_validate_response` against the selected module. The retry predicate uses the selected module's `HTTPStatusError`, `TimeoutException`, and `NetworkError`; `_build_retry_wait` reads `exc.response.headers` generically, so the same Retry-After/jitter rules apply to both exception families.
- For stdlib `httpx`, keep pydantic-ai's existing `AsyncTenacityTransport`. For `httpx2`, first check for a first-party `pydantic_ai.retries.HTTPX2TenacityTransport`; the current pinned pydantic-ai lacks it, so this patch uses a local `httpx2.AsyncBaseTransport` wrapper with the same retry/validate/close/context-manager behavior.
- Handle Anthropic 1.x beta `messages.create` signature removal by wrapping the rebar-owned `anthropic_client.beta.messages.create` instance after provider construction. Pydantic-ai's `AnthropicModel._messages_create` dispatches every real request through `self.client.beta.messages.create(...)`, so late-binding that instance method is on the real request path. The wrapper moves unsupported real sampling kwargs (`temperature`, `top_p`, `top_k`) into `extra_body` and only drops `anthropic.Omit` placeholders. Upstream capability resolution still decides whether a model gets a real sampling value; the wrapper only changes the Python-call location required by the SDK signature. Provider-parity normalization reads the final wire JSON, where `extra_body` is merged into the top-level request body.
- Widen `anthropic` to `>=0.121.0,<2`, keeping both pre-httpx2 and 1.x/httpx2 lines installable while excluding the next major line.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] `anthropic==1.2.0`: provider/model construction uses `httpx2.AsyncClient`, does not raise the old `TypeError`, and can issue a MockTransport request through `AnthropicProvider`/`AnthropicModel`.
- [x] `anthropic==0.121.0`: provider/model construction remains compatible with stdlib `httpx.AsyncClient`.
- [x] 254e retry semantics are preserved for the selected HTTP module: retry predicate, Retry-After parsing, zero/expired-header fallback, jitter wait, and `max_retries=0` guard.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_transport_retry.py` covers httpx2 construction, retry, sampling-kwarg relocation through the real pydantic-ai `AnthropicModel` request path, and a spy guard that fails if pydantic-ai stops dispatching through the late-bound `client.beta.messages.create` instance method.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_transport_retry_jitter.py` remains green for `_build_retry_wait`'s shared Retry-After/jitter contract.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_provider_parity.py` captures direct-Anthropic requests through the SDK-selected transport module and confirms sampling values remain visible in the normalized wire payload.
- [x] Existing direct-Anthropic MockTransport harnesses are updated to patch the SDK-selected transport module in `tests/unit/test_llm_fallback_chain.py`, `tests/unit/test_agentic_message_cache.py`, `tests/unit/test_llm_provider_factory.py`, `tests/unit/test_llm_timeouts.py`, `tests/unit/test_cache_prefix_breakpoint.py`, `tests/unit/test_candidate_tracing.py`, `tests/unit/test_candidate_tracing_oracle.py`, and `tests/unit/test_llm_config_gate_root.py`.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_packaging_dependencies.py` proves `0.121.0` and `1.2.0` are allowed while `2.0.0` is rejected.
- [x] Portable across CI providers / no CI: the adaptation is local Python plus dependency bounds; no provider-specific CI trigger is required.
